description: GRADUATE one of your drops to tier 4 — a real backend (server code, queryable store, isolated SQLite) behind the SAME URL, with its data carried over. This ACTS: it creates the app, moves the data across, and switches the URL over. The owner is emailed. Requires an account token and an ACTIVE app subscription (19 EUR/month per app, founding cohort, Pro included): the owner applies from their space (Grow), places are given in order of arrival, then payment activates it. The URL never changes and visitors keep their data. Pass check=true to get the verdict WITHOUT doing anything. On refusal, returns the COMPLETE list of reasons with what to do about each. Nothing is changed on a refusal — the drop keeps serving.
name: dropyour_graduate
title: Graduate a drop into a real app
